b: Gregor Johann Mendel is credited with deriving the fundamental laws of inheritance. His Law of Dominance states that in a heterozygote, one allele (the dominant allele) will mask the expression of the other allele (the recessive allele).
sec.s: Medical Biochemistry, Genetics, and Molecular Biology — Notes

qs.q: How many alleles for each gene does an organism typically inherit according to Mendelian genetics?
qs.e: Organisms inherit two alleles for each gene—one from each parent. Inheriting a single allele from only one parent contradicts the foundational principles of diploid inheritance.
